proposals.old_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.new_text: Classify the input into one or more of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.hypothesis: Changing 'exactly one of' to 'one or more of' allows the model to classify inputs that may belong to multiple categories, which is evident in several traces where multiple categories were expected.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the model recognize and output multiple relevant categories for inputs that clearly fit more than one classification.

proposals.new_text: Output the category name(s) as a comma-separated list.
proposals.hypothesis: Allowing the output to be a comma-separated list will enable the model to provide multiple classifications when necessary, addressing the failures where multiple categories were expected.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should improve the model's ability to classify inputs that fit into more than one category.

proposals.new_text: No explanation. No reasoning. If multiple categories apply, list them all.
proposals.hypothesis: Clarifying that multiple categories can be listed will guide the model to provide all relevant classifications without additional explanations.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the model understand that it can output multiple categories without violating the instruction to avoid explanations.
